decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): Both terms are attested culinary names for basil-related Ocimum herbs, but the card presents them as a clean Indonesian-versus-Malaysian contrast. Usage overlaps: Indonesian also uses selasih, and Malaysian sources attest both selasih and kemangi. The botanical referent can vary by cultivar, so the relation needs qualification and an explicit false-friend/overlap note. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
